steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, soak it for 20 to 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker on medium and let the bay leaf and cumin sizzle.
Add the sliced onion and fry on medium-low, stirring often, until golden.
Add the ginger, garlic and green chilli for 30 seconds, then the tomato, and cook 2 to 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the carrot, beans, peas, potato, capsicum and cauliflower and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add about 180 ml water a person and the salt, bring it to a rolling boil, then stir in the drained rice.
Close the lid and cook on medium-high for 1 whistle, or cover a pot and cook on low for 15 to 20 minutes, until the water is gone.
Let it rest for 10 minutes, fluff it gently with a fork and top with the coriander leaves.
note: Rice ran from 75 to 97 g a serving, and 90 g suits pulao eaten as the whole meal. Cauliflower comes from one source only and can be swapped for more of the other vegetables.
